title: JS8Call Heartbeat Silence by Station
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=js8call:message
| search msg_type=heartbeat
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by station_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| sort - hours_since
description: Shows which stationss have gone quiet for JS8Call heartbeats.
value: Heartbeat gaps usually mean the app, radio path, or relay script stopped behaving as expected.
implementation: Send JS8Call heartbeats events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of stationss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which stationss have gone quiet longer than they should for JS8Call heartbeats.
